title: Spirituals abroad, prejudice and her philosophy of life
summary: Asked about reaching a Russian audience and prejudice, she says white audiences in the South sit anywhere for gospel, and offers her life philosophy.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
